calls.statement:
SELECT 
  MIN(join_date) AS earliest_join_date,
  MAX(join_date) AS latest_join_date,
  COUNT(*) AS total_members
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE

SELECT 
  home_store_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY home_store_id
ORDER BY home_store_id
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  home_store_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS online_signup_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE AND home_store_id = 900
GROUP BY home_store_id

SELECT 
  store_id,
  store_name,
  format,
  region
FROM dim_store
WHERE is_current = TRUE AND store_id < 900
ORDER BY store_id

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN m.home_store_id = 900 THEN 900
    ELSE s.store_id
  END AS store_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN m.home_store_id = 900 THEN 'Online'
    ELSE s.store_name
  END AS store_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS new_members_2025
FROM dim_member m
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON m.home_store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE
WHERE m.is_current = TRUE
  AND YEAR(m.join_date) = 2025
GROUP BY m.home_store_id, store_id, store_name
ORDER BY store_id

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  home_store_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE AND home_store_id = 129 AND YEAR(join_date) = 2025
GROUP BY home_store_id

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS total_new_members_2025
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE AND YEAR(join_date) = 2025

SELECT 
  home_store_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE is_current = TRUE AND YEAR(join_date) = 2025 AND home_store_id IS NULL
GROUP BY home_store_id

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN m.home_store_id = 900 THEN 900
    ELSE s.store_id
  END AS store_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN m.home_store_id = 900 THEN 'Online'
    ELSE s.store_name
  END AS store_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS new_members_2025
FROM dim_member m
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON m.home_store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE
WHERE m.is_current = TRUE
  AND YEAR(m.join_date) = 2025
GROUP BY m.home_store_id, store_id, store_name
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  -1 AS store_id,
  'TOTAL' AS store_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS new_members_2025
FROM dim_member m
WHERE m.is_current = TRUE AND YEAR(m.join_date) = 2025
ORDER BY store_id
